statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-116313 (PostgreSQL "vacuumdb --missing-stats-only" lets a database owner execute code as the vacuumdb user) affects only PostgreSQL 18. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116313/, says versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected and lists 18.7 as the only fixed release, and the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116313, lists only major version 18 as affected. The flaw is in the catalog query vacuumdb runs for its --missing-stats-only option. That option was added in PostgreSQL 18 by commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/edba754f052ea0c02287080004aa6051eaa4f597 and is listed in the PostgreSQL 18 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.0/. The fix, https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/1ce3bce608dc504ca8849d42abcccc7820b88e48, schema-qualifies that query's operators and is marked back-patch through 18. src/bin/scripts/vacuumdb.c at every PostgreSQL 16 release this owner publishes (REL_16_13 through REL_16_16) has no --missing-stats-only option; see for example https://github.com/postgres/postgres/blob/REL_16_16/src/bin/scripts/vacuumdb.c. The vacuumdb program in every published DHI postgresql16-client build for Alpine 3.23 (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0), on both x86_64 and aarch64, reports its 16.x release and does not contain the string missing-stats-only, which the postgresql18-client 18.7-r0 vacuumdb does contain on both architectures. None of the Alpine patches applied in the 16.16-r0 APKBUILD touch vacuumdb. The 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, do not list this CVE. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 secfixes list CVE-2026-116313, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD, but upstream's own advisory places PostgreSQL 16 outside the affected range.
